A.brief_rationale: Mentions shallow measurement focused near the borehole/flushed zone and says the pad helps focused measurement, but does not state the key reason that the flushed zone may extend only a few inches or that the pad reduces borehole/mud short-circuit effects. Also includes unsupported description of flushed zone as formed by groundwater flow around a core.

B.brief_rationale: Correctly explains that the pad contacts the borehole wall to reduce borehole-fluid bypass and measure the near-wall flushed zone. However, it does not explicitly include the specific textbook point that the flushed zone may extend only a few inches beyond the borehole wall.

C.brief_rationale: Directly states both required claims from the cited span: very shallow investigation because the flushed zone may extend only a few inches, and sidewall pad use to avoid borehole effects.
